items.name: Raspberry Pi 4 Model B — 4GB default
items.description: Complete Raspberry Pi 4 Model B, 4GB LPDDR4 variant. Official product brief p3: BCM2711 quad-core Cortex-A72, two USB 2.0 and two USB 3.0 ports, 40-pin GPIO, microSD storage, USB-C 5V supply minimum 3A subject to p5 footnote. 3A is supply sizing, not measured consumption. Customer-supplied SBC docks through40-pin GPIO and is mechanically supported; not CM or a soldered component. Baseboard supplies regulated5V through header power contacts; no internalUSB-C cable.
items.selection_reason: User-supplied Pi4B,4GB remains default reference. Quantity1 is the assembled reference, not a board to buy with product kit. Baseboard mates viaGPIO; board revision/other models not yet qualified. User requests simple mount and enclosure access to native ports; no addedbaseboardUSB-A. User installation should not require soldering or individual GPIO jumpers. UsernowselectsPiUSB-Ccovered/interlockedwhiledocked;baseboardinputonly. Othernativeportsremainaccessible. Pi4B reference now placed with USB/RJ45 rear and micro-HDMI/AV right. Openings derive from imported board geometry; retention, actual plugs, GPIO stack and production fit remain unverified. No front ports.
items.supply_risk: Supplier query returned unrelated passive/diode/crystal rows; all rejected. No stock, price, reseller SKU or board-revision claim. Procurement availability is advisory; thermal and power integration remain unresolved.

items.name: Upper enclosure with integrated PCB beams and rear guide
items.description: Printed upper shell, 76x115x27mm exterior, printed deck-down with no support material: flat deck (expansion cover sits on top), full-height screw columns for the bottom cover, roof-backed PCB beams, 51-degree rear PCB guide. No fan bosses, cassette, pads or fan screws; existing left slots are passive ventilation. Rear USB/RJ45 windows open to the lower edge and inner grooves for the audio jack/USB-C let it drop straight over the Pi. Three internal receivers extend down to Z5.4 to accept the flat Pi carrier ears; use together with the flat carrier. CAD default PLA; print fit, strength and service life untested. Four integral roof tabs carry the screen pod via concealed underside screws; front diameter2.4mm and rear diameter3.4mm driver paths; front paths remain within the original inner cavity. Remove Pi with its independent carrier before screen service.
items.selection_reason: 76mm enclosure and76x59mm screen housing face with equal4.75mm borders outside66.5x49.5mm shallow border line. Glass/FPC datum unchanged; user accepts front rise approximately1.67mm. Front retainer screws at local(+/-27,-26.25), rear(+/-20,25.5); shell wells retained; independent bezel and thin flange removed. Rear pod foot stays flush atY57.5 with approximately26.29deg forward lean. Pi/heatsink offsetX-5mm, 44.5x83.5mm released PCB and capsule slots retained for passive ventilation. Existing85mm enclosure/PCB releases are not interchangeable. Side ports now clear default straight overmould envelopes12x6mm USB-C,11x6mm per micro-HDMI and diameter10mm audio, with enlarged full-depth bores and1.5mm HDMI separator; these are negative enclosure-clearance targets, not verified purchasable cable identities. Paired with M3 front-module and bottom-cover receivers, rear M3 pod mounts, and the current M2 retainer.
